checks.claim: The PCE base rate was set at 19.35 cents/kWh
checks.evidence: Regulatory Commission of Alaska notice dated May 1, 2026 (docket U-26-010) states the current PCE base amount is 20.38 cents per kWh and proposes 22.11 cents/kWh for FY2027. The 19.35 figure was set June 13, 2023 and is no longer the current base.
checks.correction: The PCE base rate, set at 19.35 cents/kWh in 2023, was 20.38 cents/kWh in 2026, with 22.11 proposed for FY2027
